title: ilex neogracilis
intro: Ilex neogracilis, commonly known as the Taiwanese holly, is a species of plant in the family Aquifoliaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Ilex neogracilis include acting as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Ilex neogracilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
